title: Anthropic’s near-$2tn IPO rests on a revenue forecast for 2028
summary: Anthropic’s revenue run rate sat at roughly $47bn as of May 2026, up from about $9bn at the end of 2025, so the reported 2028 target implies revenue more than quadrupling again in a little over two years.
